builds.name: Reference: Ultimate window
builds.goal: Reference for Lissandra: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A close-range control mage who uses claw repositioning to enter, lock targets and turn nearby deaths into follow-up threats. Measure claw entry, self-R versus enemy R and passive thrall follow-up. A support tank route trades AP for reliable control; no simultaneous offensive and defensive R. Mana and ultimate-oriented item effects test repeated impactful R windows.
builds.summary: Mana and ultimate-oriented item effects test repeated impactful R windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Lissandra: Measure claw entry, self-R versus enemy R and passive thrall follow-up. A support tank route trades AP for reliable control; no simultaneous offensive and defensive R.

Start with the early core (Malignance only if the R interaction is confirmed, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Mana and ultimate-oriented item effects test repeated impactful R windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.
